Workflow.name: Access Request Workflow
Workflow.description: End-to-end access request lifecycle with conditional approval routing

Variable.name: identityName
Variable.description: Name of the identity requesting access

Variable.name: requestor
Variable.description: Name of the identity who submitted the request

Variable.name: requestId
Variable.description: Generated unique ID for this request, used for audit tracking

Variable.name: approvalDecision
Variable.description: Result of manager approval step: Approved or Rejected

Variable.name: requiresSecurityApproval
Variable.description: Boolean flag set during initialise if request contains privileged access

Variable.name: provisioningResult
Variable.description: Final provisioning status returned to the caller

Step.name: Initialise
Step.Description: Validate the incoming provisioning plan and set workflow context variables. Checks for privileged entitlements that require security team approval.

Step.name: Manager Approval
Step.Description: Routes the access request to the requestor's direct manager for approval. Times out after 48 hours and escalates to the manager's manager.

Step.name: Security Approval
Step.Description: Conditional approval step for requests containing privileged entitlements. Routes to the Security Operations team. SLA: 24 hours.

Step.name: Provision
Step.Description: Executes the approved provisioning plan. Captures the provisioning result for notification and audit purposes.

Step.name: Notify Requestor
Step.Description: Sends a completion notification to the requestor confirming that the requested access has been provisioned.

Step.name: Rejected
Step.Description: Notifies the requestor that their access request has been rejected and records the rejection in the audit trail.
